questions.question: Sandbox tracker: net job approval (percent approve minus percent disapprove) among US registered voters, as the dashboard shows it on Friday 2028-01-07. This round is a rehearsal and is never scored.
questions.resolve: nothing: the sandbox never resolves. It exists so the submission path can be exercised end to end without entering the season.

questions.question: Sandbox tracker: net job approval in each of four party groups on 2028-01-07, as one joint profile. Every cell is required -- the energy score is a norm over the whole vector, so a profile with a hole has no score. This round is a rehearsal and is never scored.
questions.unit: net points (approve minus disapprove), per cell

questions.question: Sandbox tracker: the five sandbox topics in order of the attention they take in the week ending 2028-01-09, rank 1 first. The basket is fixed, so the answer is a permutation of exactly these five. This round is a rehearsal and is never scored.
questions.unit: ordered list of 5 sandbox topics, rank 1 first
